task: Add a read-only learning_effectiveness CLI reporting (1) a fast per-story hint predictive-value signal computed retrodictively over findings+signatureTags in temporal order, and (2) an ON/OFF arm comparison from the experience_hint_surfaced hintMode events, with honest N and significance.
outcome:
Running `node bin/lattice.js learning_effectiveness` prints a report the operator can read, e.g.:

  Experience Layer — effectiveness
  Predictive value (retrodictive, prior-story signatures):
    stories: 40   pre-warnable findings: 120   recall: 0.21   precision: 0.34
    trend (windows of 25): hit-rate 0.10 -> 0.18 -> 0.22  (slope +)
  A/B arms (from experience_hint_surfaced hintMode):
    ON  n=3   recurrence-outcome 0.30
    OFF n=2   recurrence-outcome 0.31
    delta -0.01   significant: NO (insufficient N; need >= <threshold> per arm)
  (advisory, read-only — observational; the A/B causal claim accrues over future stories)

With --json it prints the structured report. --confirmedOnly restricts to signatureTagSource=confirmed.
facts: readActivityLogTail (core/activity-log.ts:46) reads experience_hint_surfaced events; B-06b3 (3.3) stamps each with hintMode (on/off) + hintIds.
store.readFindings exposes findings incl. signatureTag (B-5d48 populates it; source auto/confirmed); store.readStory exposes createdAt for temporal ordering; listStoryIds enumerates.

learning_validate (B-a2e3) is the read-only handler template: derives WITHOUT projectRoot, own git call in try/catch, writes nothing, registered L0 experience-layer-read + in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS + process-fact-levels.

The FAST predictive-value layer needs only findings+signatureTags+order (no hint events); the LONG-GAME RCT layer needs the hintMode events. Forward arm data is currently sparse, so the RCT will honestly report 'not yet significant' until N accrues / the 3.5 backfill lands.
constraints: Read-only: writes nothing, files no findings, touches no gate; the leaf is pure (no fs/git), inject the ordered story data.
Honest by construction: report N per arm + a conservative significance gate; never claim a causal win before the N gate is met; the fast signal is observational.
Never NaN; deterministic given fixed inputs.

Registered exactly like a read-only command (L0 experience-layer-read, READ_ONLY_COMMANDS, process-fact-levels, command-policy readOnly) — adding a new command requires the process-fact-levels entry or the process-fact-contract suite fails (lesson from B-a2e3).
unknowns: The recurrence outcome for the arm comparison — resolved: fraction of a story's findings whose signatureTag was already known from prior stories (a higher value = more un-caught recurrence); compare ON vs OFF.
The significance gate — resolved: a conservative minimum N per arm (e.g. >= a small constant); below it, significant=false with note='insufficient N'. No p-value claim beyond that.
